workarounds.symptom: [Bug] --session-chat crashes when resuming any session with prior messages
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(session): restore full history in session chat. Target files: agent/src/session/store.py, agent/tests/test_cli_session_id.py, agent/tests/test_session_store_messages_corrupt.py. - Treat `limit=None` as a request for the complete chronological message history in `SessionStore`. - Add a regression that resumes `--session-chat` with persisted user and assistant messages and verifies they reach the next agent turn. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading/pull/2249)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] langchain-openai 1.8.2 leaves per-instance async transports open
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(providers): close per-instance async default transports. Target files: agent/src/providers/chat.py, agent/src/providers/llm.py, agent/tests/test_chat_llm_lifecycle.py. - Track `langchain-openai 1.8.2+` default async HTTPX clients as instance-owned and close them with their `ChatLLM` adapter. - Keep cached synchronous defaults borrowed and preserve explicit client ownership behavior. - Update the lifecycle regression to cover both cached and per-instance transports over real local HTTP requests. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading/pull/2255)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Model discovery ignores direct transport setting and uses ambient proxy
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(providers): honor direct mode during model discovery. Target files: agent/src/api/settings_routes.py, agent/src/providers/discovery.py, agent/.env.example. - Apply the existing `VIBE_TRADING_DISABLE_HTTP_PROXY` contract to live model discovery, not only chat requests. - Preserve environment-proxy behavior by default and keep `SSL_CERT_FILE` / `SSL_CERT_DIR` support in direct mode. - Add real loopback coverage for saved and exported settings, with direct and proxy controls. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading/pull/2236)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug] Grounding gate redacts every figure quoted from an uploaded PDF — read_document text never enters the evidence ledger
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(grounding): let figures quoted from a read document enter the ledger. Target files: agent/src/agent/grounding/evidence.py, agent/src/agent/grounding/ledger.py, agent/tests/test_grounding_document_figures.py. Numbers a document states now become observed evidence, so an answer written from an uploaded PDF grounds on it instead of being redacted. (Ref: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading/pull/2058)
